snippet.title: No Vacation For An Executioner - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2949120/No_Vacation_for_an_Executioner/

Visit our website for the full catalog, news, and exclusive content:
https://www.survivalhorrors.com

Subscribe for more survival horror content:
https://www.youtube.com/@survivalhorrors-com

Step into the dark and twisted world of No Vacation for an Executioner, a retro PS2-style Survival Horror Action-RPG from Hong Kong developer and publisher Jay O. In this Steam PC title, you play as a frustrated executioner in the late 17th century who abandons his grim duties—only to unleash a riot of monsters. Now, you must fight to survive, uncover the dark truth behind the mysterious “Gloomy Oil,” and decide the fate of this brutal world.

Game Details:
🕹 Genre: Survival Horror, RPG, Third-Person
💻 Platform: Steam PC – Game ID: 2949120
📅 Release Date: 1st Season of 2026
🌍 Developer/Publisher: Jay O – Hong Kong, China

Key Features:

Unique retro art style & freaky atmosphere

Visuals inspired by the late 17th & early 18th century

Special battle system that rewards precise timing over button-mashing

Multiple secrets to uncover and 4+ different endings

🔍 Tags: No Vacation for an Executioner gameplay, Steam demo, survival horror RPG, PS2 retro style game, dark fantasy action RPG, Hong Kong indie game, monster horror game, third person horror PC game, Jay O games, gloomy oil story
